editorial.blurb: A late-night Chinatown favorite with authentic Chinese comfort food, reasonable prices, and a loyal following who keep coming back for standout dishes like salt and pepper shrimp and wonton noodle soup.
editorial.insiderTip: Order takeout or dine in after 10 PM when the kitchen is in full stride—delivery gets turned off during peak times, but walk-ins are always welcomed, and the food shines when made fresh to order.
signatureDishes: General Tso chicken (or fried tofu swap)
